svg.title: Which canonical groups each expression set fills
svg.desc: One row per group of the canonical expression and viseme sets, with its number of signals, one column per expression set. "in" means an in-map writes the group from the set; "out" means an out-map writes the set from the group. The last column shows the groups that the viseme pose bridge reads and writes.
svg.text: Which canonical groups each expression set fills
Data 0.5.0. "in": an in-map writes the group from the set. "out": an out-map writes the set from the group. A route needs both ends.
Both canonical sets are drafts (vocabulary status "draft").
The bridge reads only the viseme classes that passed its calibration record; it maps no expression back to visemes.
Source: generated/rcef.pack.json. README "Routes" lists every route.
